description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Amphenol Network Solutions is hiring a junior software developer to build and support internal business applications, including Epicor Kinetic ERP customizations and its .NET-based intranet tools. The role partners with business users to translate operational needs into software and supports integrations, reporting, troubleshooting, and development practices.
Junior Software Engineer building Epicor Kinetic customizations, SQL Server solutions, and internal applications and integrations

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain Epicor Kinetic customizations, including BPMs, Epicor Functions, BAQs, dashboards, and integrations through the Kinetic REST API
• Build, enhance, and support applications in our internal intranet tool suite
• Write and tune SQL Server queries, views, and stored procedures that support reporting and business processes
• Integrate internal systems with Epicor and third-party services through APIs
• Gather requirements directly from users in manufacturing, engineering, sales, and finance, and translate them into working solutions
• Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, and provide second-level support for the tools the team owns
• Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and debugging, and help the team refine how we use them
• Write tests, participate in code reviews, and document work so others can support it

Requirements:
• 0–2 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent hands-on experience through internships, academic projects, or personal work
• Experience building at least one complete application, from data layer to user interface
• Familiarity with version control (Git) and issue tracking
• Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and business domains as needs evolve
• Working knowledge of C# and .NET; experience with Java, TypeScript, Python, or a similar language is also welcome
• Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server
• Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and web application fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• Hands-on use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) and genuine curiosity about new development tools
• Ability to break down an ambiguous business request into clear, buildable pieces
• Ability to write readable, maintainable code and follow established coding standards
• Foundational debugging and troubleshooting skills
• Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential
• the ability to ask good questions, explain technical tradeoffs plainly, and document work clearly is required
• The developer should be comfortable receiving feedback, asking for help early, and collaborating openly with teammates
• Proficiency with modern development tools is central to this role, including Visual Studio or VS Code, Git, and issue tracking platforms
• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools, and the judgment to review and verify their output, is expected
• Adaptability to new software and platforms is essential given how quickly our tooling is evolving

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
• Exposure to an ERP system, ideally Epicor Kinetic
• Experience with ASP.NET Core, Blazor, or a modern front-end framework
• Interest in manufacturing, supply chain, or business operations
• Familiarity with SQL Server Management Studio, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint is beneficial
